@RepMikeCarey How about legislation to provide a tax credit for families who adopt, fuck infertility treatments.

Helping families afford fertility treatments is a noble goal, but layering more tax credits onto an already broken system isn’t the answer. The Infertility Treatment Affordability Act (H.R. 10393) mirrors adoption tax credits that have done little to reduce bureaucratic bloat or streamline processes.

Instead of creating new IRS-managed programs, expand Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Arrangements to include fertility care—letting families control their healthcare dollars tax-free without D.C. middlemen. Real financial freedom means cutting red tape, not adding more conditional handouts tied to political pet projects.

Address the root issue: medical price-gouging by hospitals and insurers driving up IVF costs, not just shifting the bill to taxpayers.
